story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.title: Who raised you?
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.sub: Your family's place in the world shaped your first years.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.farmers.tale: Your parents worked the land from first light, and you worked beside them.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.smiths.tale: Your family dug ore and beat it into tools, the way the Anvil-Father likes it done, and you grew strong carrying it.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.fisherfolk.t: Your family lived off the water and gave the Deep Mother back a little of every catch, and you learned to keep your feet on a rolling deck.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.hunters.tale: Your family lived off what they could track and shoot and wasted none of it, as the Green Huntsman asks, and you learned to keep a steady hand.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.merchants.ta: Your family drove caravans between the towns, and you learned to count coin and read a face.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.soldiers.tal: Your parents served in a realm's ranks, and drilled you as soon as you could hold a stick.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.healers.tale: Your family tended the sick and the fallen at the Hearthkeeper's house, and you learned what the body needs to mend.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.wizard.tale: A hedge-wizard took you in and set you to grinding his powders and copying his notes.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.outlaws.tale: Your family lived outside the law and whispered their thanks to the Ash Whisperer, and you learned to move quietly and leave no trace.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.nobles.tale: Your family held a small title in %s, and you learned the manners of the court.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.foundling.ta: Nobody claimed you. You were left on a doorstep and raised by whoever was kind that year.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.tinkerer: The Mad Tinkerer, on his workbench
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.tinkerer.tal: The Mad Tinkerer kept you on his workbench long after you were finished, opening you up to see what you could take, and you took all of it.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.vatkin: Older vat-born, hiding in the sewers
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.vatkin.tale: Older vat-born who had slipped the Tinkerer found you and hid you in the sewers under a town, and taught you to stay out of sight.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.vatkin.short: Hidden in the sewers by vat-kin.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.acrobats.tal: The fair's acrobats raised you between their acts, and you learned to fall, bounce and come up smiling.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.ringmaster.t: The ringmaster raised you as the heir to the show, and you learned to hold a crowd in the palm of your hand.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.keepers: The keepers of the water temple
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.keepers.tale: The old keepers of the water temple raised you in its drowned halls, and taught you the Deep Mother's prayers and her tides.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.grovekeepers: The grove-keepers raised you among the oldest trees, and taught you which roots heal and which ones kill.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.elders: A Verdant elder, who taught you to heal
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.elders.tale: A Verdant elder raised you, and taught you how the sun feeds you and how a wound can be coaxed closed.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.elders.short: A Verdant elder, who taught you to heal.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.hornkin: Hornkin of the Nether, paid off in gold
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.hornkin.tale: The expedition paid the Hornkin off in gold, and one of their war-bands took you in as part of the bargain. You learned their pride and how hard a horned head can hit.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.hornkin.shor: Raised by Hornkin, as part of a bargain.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.wolves.tale: Lost in the snow as a baby, you were found and kept by a pack of white wolves, and learned to hunt before you learned to talk.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.wolves.short: Raised by a pack of snow wolves.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.barrows.tale: Your family kept the Lantern Warden's lights burning on the old barrows of the moor, and you grew up among the dead, learning which ones stay asleep.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.chieftain.ta: The warband's chief raised you at their own fire, and expected you to fight for your place at it every night.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.master.tale: An old master of the fighting arts took you on as a pupil, and made you carry stones up his hill until you stopped complaining.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.master.short: Pupil of an old martial master.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.sunpriests.t: The priests of the Crowned Sun raised you to greet the first light every morning, and to fear nothing that hides from it.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.sunpriests.s: Raised by the Crowned Sun's priests.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.pack.tale: The pack raised you, fur and feather and scale together, and taught you to hunt, to hide and to know who is friend by the smell of them.
